title: Derived mate transport in the base coordinates
statement: Choose derived categories of scheme modules [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $f:X\to S$, $g:S\prime\to S$, $g\prime:X\prime\to X$, $f\prime:X\prime\to S\prime$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with $h:g\prime f=f\prime g$. Let $e_S:S\cong A$, $e_T:S\prime\cong B$, put $f_A=f e_S$, $g_A=e_T^{-1}g e_S$, $T=R(e_T^{-1})_*$, and let $h_A$ witness $g\prime f_A=(f\prime e_T)g_A$. There exist natural isomorphisms $b:Rf\prime_*\cong R(f\prime e_T)_*\,T$ and $a:Rf_*\,Lg^*\cong Rf_{A,*}\,Lg_A^*\,T$ [def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-direct-image] such that for every $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$, $\beta(h)_E\,b_{Lg\prime^*E}=a_E\,T(\beta(h_A)_E)$ for the pinned mates [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. No cartesian hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Remark 20.28.3, counit description; Lemmas 20.27.2 (0D5S) and 20.28.2 (0D5T), composition

proof.text: Postcompose f and g with eS.hom. The original square equality composed with eS.hom gives the intermediate commutative square. Apply the codomain-isomorphism transport law to get aS and beta_original = aS followed by beta_intermediate.
Apply the domain-isomorphism transport law to the intermediate square and eT, using hA, to get b and aT with beta_intermediate followed by b = aT followed by R(eT.inv) of beta_final.
Set a=aS followed by aT, retain b, and substitute the two equalities. Associativity of morphisms and the component formula for a composite natural isomorphism give the required equation for every E.

theorem exists_derivedBaseChange_base_coordinates
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (h : g' ≫ f = f' ≫ g)
    {A B : Scheme.{u}} (eS : S ≅ A) (eT : S' ≅ B)
    (hA : g' ≫ (f ≫ eS.hom) =
      (f' ≫ eT.hom) ≫ (eT.inv ≫ g ≫ eS.hom)) :
    let fA := f ≫ eS.hom
    let gA := eT.inv ≫ g ≫ eS.hom
    let T := schemeDerivedDirectImage eT.inv
    ∃ b : schemeDerivedDirectImage f' ≅
        schemeDerivedDirectImage (f' ≫ eT.hom) ⋙ T,
    ∃ a : schemeDerivedDirectImage f ⋙ derivedPullback g ≅
        schemeDerivedDirectImage fA ⋙ derivedPullback gA ⋙ T,
      ∀ E : schemeDerivedCategory X,
        schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f f' g g' h E ≫
            b.hom.app ((derivedPullback g').obj E) =
          a.hom.app E ≫ T.map
            (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap fA (f' ≫ eT.hom) gA g' hA E)
